name: Tsuba Millinery
description: An elegant, sculptural store theme for a small milliner's atelier in Hoshikawa City: cloches, boaters, buckets and wide brims blocked by hand, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Felt-blush pages, petal cells, ink text and one muted mauve accent; Della Respira for display, Sen for text. The header (H12) sets the wordmark on the left and a numbered menu list in the corner; the home page (L14) opens on a layered paper-cut hat block and goes straight to a filter-first catalogue (shape, material, head size) with each hat on a plain blush cell. The footer (F3) is one line of shop details. Fit & sizing, Made to order, Atelier, journal, newsletter and contact. The shop card, the sizing guide and the shapes table each live in one synced pattern; material and brim print under every price (WooCommerce optional: without it the shop shows a static catalogue and orders go by email).

summary.zh-TW: 為手工製帽工坊打造的典雅商店主題：依帽型、材質與頭圍篩選，附尺寸指南與訂製服務。
summary.en: An elegant store for a small milliner, with a filter-first hat catalogue, a sizing guide and made-to-order fittings.
summary.ja: 小さな帽子工房のための上品なストア。帽子の形・素材・サイズで探せるカタログとサイズガイド付き。
summary.fr: Une boutique élégante pour une petite modiste : catalogue filtré par forme, guide des tailles et sur-mesure.
summary.de: Ein eleganter Shop für eine kleine Hutmacherei, mit filterbarem Hutkatalog, Größenratgeber und Maßanfertigung.

deviation: Codes: H12 + F3 + L14 as assigned. Palette felt blush #F6EFEF, petal #E8DCDC, ink #2E2628 and muted mauve #A27C80 (marks, rules and large type only) plus deep mauve #7A5257 for links and small labels, smoke #665A5D for quiet text and seam #D9C8C9 hairlines. Fonts: Della Respira (OFL-1.1 with Reserved Font Name, shipped unmodified) and Sen (variable, OFL-1.1) as unmodified TTF in assets/fonts. Visual style layered paper-cut: hero, collection, atelier and fit illustrations AI-generated with Grok Build image_gen and checked by eye for text, marks and logos; product pictures are crops of the collection illustration. New industry millinery, new page tags fit-sizing and made-to-order.
